correctness.rationale: From P(X)=φ(X)B and P²=P, both averaging identities force B²=λB and λφ(I)=1, hence λ≠0. Put E=B/λ=P(I), obtain E²=E and φ normalization; the nondegenerate trace pairing yields unique C with EC=CE=C, tr C=1. GL_n acts transitively on rank-r E; the stabilizer GL_r×GL_{n-r} identifies C with an affine trace-one hyperplane and gives dimension 2nr−r²−1 and {n bracket r}_q q^(nr−1) points. Conjugation reduces to trace-one r×r matrix similarity. Rational canonical forms and additive character orthogonality give (K_q(r)−1_{p|r}K_q(r/p))/q orbits. Fixed-q corank weights {n bracket j}_q q^(−nj) converge by summable t^(j²) bounds; Rogers–Ramanujan evaluates the norm. Independently counted M2(F2) as 6+8 and M2(F3) as 12+27, including both averaging laws; this is finite corroboration, not proof of all n.
residual_risks: The geometric assertions concern reduced loci only, not a nonreduced operator scheme; the checker covers only two prime fields and n=2.
